assessment.report:
# Proactive project rules follow-up preflight

The user explicitly approved automatically checking target-project instruction adequacy during work and asking before creating or modifying root or nested instructions. Implementation authority is for kit source, not other real target writes, global settings, installation, commit or push. Retain 0.10.0 because the capability is uncommitted and unpublished; this is a bounded completion of that capability, not a separately released version.

Current project instructions, existing scope review, release policy, architecture, Skill and canonical contract were inspected. The existing workflow already has partial automatic preflight routing; its explicit-request openings and first-creation/policy-only wording need alignment with approved automatic notification plus all-target-edit scope approval. No runtime/helper/policy-number/schema/architecture redesign is needed. No active applicable PRD exists in the bounded unchanged inventory; prior independent-feature materials are unrelated and not recertified.

The minimum contract: at task start, entering a relevant module and encountering relevant changed facts, inspect only necessary root-to-module chains. Propose only when concrete relevant evidence shows a durable working-guidance gap. Absence, age and shortness alone are insufficient. Lead consolidates child findings and explains exact path, evidence, task impact and bounded delta before seeking actual user approval. General development authority is not target-rules edit authority. Existing explicit scope approval counts; do not require redundant approvals for already-approved changes. Preserve user passages and root/override precedence. Nested files require meaningful stable distinct module rules; general rules go root and large detail stays in linked sources. No recursive global audit/background hook/automatic host-loading promise.

Reuse reachable current decision evidence to suppress repeat approved/refused/deferred proposals until material relevant facts or scope change; absence of a durable decision record is not proof none exists or a cross-session suppression guarantee. Use existing chat/task/governance conventions; no new tracker. Declining preserves rules and independent authorized development. Material ambiguity pauses only dependent work.

Ownership: reuse /root/project_rules_tester originally selected team-tester for additive packet/affected verification; /root/project_rules_docs originally selected team-docs-maintainer for source Skill/reference/workflow routes, bounded profile wording and paired public docs; later reuse /root/project_rules_reviewer selected team-reviewer for independent frozen-source/semantic verification. Needed exact roles are in current tool catalog; no generic fallback or child orchestration. Host resolved identities/models remain unreported. Main owns review publication and integration. Preserve all earlier dirty source edits.

Tester prepared CASE-PR-F01..F05 and practical semantic/manual-E2E checkpoints before production edits. Instruction behavior uses manual-or-environmental track with a real-environment rationale; no fabricated Red or wording-regex tests. Native distribution/doc-pair/bilingual regression/stage gates run on frozen sources. Prior runtime/helper results may be reused only with exact unchanged relevant-input identity; real loaded Codex E2E/human acceptance remain pending. Review is sufficient for approved bounded writers to begin after current packet validation, not tested correctness or user acceptance.
